description: This file defines the interface for a TFTP (Trivial File Transfer Protocol) client library, including constants, data structures, enums, and function prototypes for getting and putting files over TFTP.

methods.name: tftp_get
methods.description: Function to retrieve a file from a remote TFTP server.

methods.name: tftp_put
methods.description: Function to send a file to a remote TFTP server.
